DarGlobal PLC is an international real estate developer specializing in exclusive luxury developments across the world’s most coveted cosmopolitan cities.

Listed on the London Stock Exchange, DarGlobal goes beyond property development; it drives economic transformation by attracting international clients and Foreign Direct Investment (FDI). Frequently Asked Questions
What is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the first and only Trump-branded development in the Middle East, delivered by DarGlobal. It combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in a single address on Sheikh Zayed Road, with direct access to Downtown Dubai.
What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
The Trump Residences offer one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, ranging from 109 to 722 sqm. Every unit is positioned to deliver a guaranteed view of either the Arabian Sea or the Burj Khalifa.

title: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai | DarGlobal
content:
When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed?
The project is under development with handover scheduled for December 2031. DarGlobal is the master developer. Buyers purchasing off-plan should contact the DarGlobal sales team directly for current payment plan terms and availability.
Where exactly is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai located?
The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown.
Does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai have the world's highest pool?

title: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai | DarGlobal
content:
Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities.
What is the Trump Members-Only Club?
The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool.

title: Trump Tower Jeddah | Seafront Residences by DarGlobal
content:
Trump Tower Jeddah is a 47-floor Trump-branded seafront residential tower on the Jeddah Corniche, developed by DarGlobal. It offers one- to four-bedroom apartments and three- and four-bedroom penthouses with direct Red Sea views, alongside the Trump Private Club for residents and members.
What unit types and sizes are available at Trump Tower Jeddah?
The tower offers one-, two-, three-, and four-bedroom apartments as well as three- and four-bedroom penthouses, ranging from 70 to 365 sqm. All units are positioned on the Jeddah Corniche and face the Red Sea.
When will Trump Tower Jeddah be completed?
Completion is scheduled for December 2029. The project is under development by DarGlobal. Buyers can contact the sales team directly for current availability, payment plan structure, and brochure download.

title: Trump Tower Jeddah | Seafront Residences by DarGlobal
content:

Is Trump Tower Jeddah developed by the Trump Organization?
No. Trump Tower Jeddah is owned and developed by DarGlobal Holdings Real Estate, which uses the Trump name and mark under a licensing agreement. The Trump Organization is not the owner, developer, or seller of the property.
What is the Trump Private Club at Trump Tower Jeddah?
The Trump Private Club is a resident-focused facility within the tower offering fine dining, a cigar lounge, meeting rooms, a gym, a yoga zone, swimming pool pool, kids pool, jacuzzi, and 24/7 concierge services.

What is Trump International Hotel Oman?
Trump International Hotel Oman is a luxury hotel at AIDA, Muscat, where investors purchase freehold ownership of individual rooms or suites. The hotel is managed by Trump Hotels, and owners earn a share of revenue from guest bookings while receiving two weeks of complimentary personal use each year.
What does owning a hotel room at Trump International Hotel Oman mean?

title: Invest in Trump International Hotel Oman | DarGlobal
content:
Owners hold freehold title to a specific room or suite within the hotel. Trump Hotels manages the property professionally, generating rental income from guest bookings. Owners receive a share of that revenue and retain two weeks annually for personal use, giving a tangible asset with managed returns.
What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel Oman?
The hotel offers rooms, junior suites, and suites ranging from 43 to 138 sqm. All units are managed by Trump Hotels as part of the hotel's operational inventory, ensuring professional management and a consistent stream of bookings.
When will Trump International Hotel Oman be completed?
Completion is scheduled for December 2028. The hotel is under development within the AIDA master community in Muscat. Contact DarGlobal for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details.

title: Invest in Trump International Hotel Oman | DarGlobal
content:
Where is Trump International Hotel Oman located?
The hotel is within AIDA, a master-planned destination in Muscat, rising 130 metres above sea level and 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport. AIDA includes a championship golf course, beach, night club, wellness centres, hiking and mountain bike trails, retail, and dining venues.
What are the benefits of hotel room ownership versus residential investment?
Hotel room ownership generates passive income from guest bookings, comes with full Trump Hotels professional management, and includes two weeks of complimentary personal use per year. Owners hold freehold title to a tangible hospitality asset without the management burden of private rental.

Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Frequently Asked Questions
What types of properties are available at Amaya?
Amaya is a 1-million-square-meter master-planned community by Dar Global in central Jeddah. In addition to completed villas and custom land plots, Amaya offers townhouses, mid-to-high-rise residential and commercial plots, and branded or serviced residences, including Trump Plaza.
Is Jeddah good for property investment?

title: Amaya
content:
Jeddah is one of Saudi Arabia's largest and most active real estate markets, driven by its status as a commercial hub and gateway city on the Red Sea coast. Demand for residential property in Jeddah is supported by a growing population, ongoing infrastructure investment, and ambitious national development plans under Saudi Vision 2030. Villas and land plots, like those offered at Amaya, tend to appeal to buyers seeking long-term ownership and the option to customize their homes. For buyers considering the Gulf Cooperation Council region, Jeddah offers a relatively stable entry point into a maturing property market with room for continued growth.
How much does a villa or plot in Jeddah cost?

title: Amaya
content:
Pricing for villas and land plots at Amaya in Jeddah depends on unit size, plot dimensions, and current inventory availability. DarGlobal has not published a fixed price list for the community, as costs vary based on the specific villa type or plot chosen. Buyers interested in Amaya should reach out directly to DarGlobal or an authorized sales representative to get up-to-date pricing for available units. This approach ensures buyers receive accurate figures reflecting the latest release phase and any applicable offers.
Jeddah vs Riyadh — which is better to buy property?
Amaya sits in a prime central location along King Abdulaziz Road, directly opposite the Red Sea Mall and minutes from the Jeddah Corniche. This gives buyers a coastal lifestyle address with direct connectivity to key urban and historic hubs.
What is the process for buying property in Jeddah?

title: Amaya
content:
Amaya offers full freehold ownership options for foreign buyers. Additionally, qualifying real estate investments at Amaya may enable eligible international buyers to apply for the Saudi Premium Residency.
What amenities are near Amaya?
In addition to nearby schools, medical clinics, and mosques, Amaya features signature community amenities. These include a 700-meter central parkland, shaded green walking trails, integrated retail courtyards, and the 4,000-square-meter members-only Vitality Club.

Frequently Asked Questions
What types of properties are available at Amaya?
Amaya is a 1-million-square-meter master-planned community by Dar Global in central Jeddah. In addition to completed villas and custom land plots, Amaya offers townhouses, mid-to-high-rise residential and commercial plots, and branded or serviced residences, including Trump Plaza.
Is Jeddah good for property investment?

title: Amaya
content:
Jeddah is one of Saudi Arabia's largest and most active real estate markets, driven by its status as a commercial hub and gateway city on the Red Sea coast. Demand for residential property in Jeddah is supported by a growing population, ongoing infrastructure investment, and ambitious national development plans under Saudi Vision 2030. Villas and land plots, like those offered at Amaya, tend to appeal to buyers seeking long-term ownership and the option to customize their homes. For buyers considering the Gulf Cooperation Council region, Jeddah offers a relatively stable entry point into a maturing property market with room for continued growth.
How much does a villa or plot in Jeddah cost?

title: Amaya
content:
Pricing for villas and land plots at Amaya in Jeddah depends on unit size, plot dimensions, and current inventory availability. DarGlobal has not published a fixed price list for the community, as costs vary based on the specific villa type or plot chosen. Buyers interested in Amaya should reach out directly to DarGlobal or an authorized sales representative to get up-to-date pricing for available units. This approach ensures buyers receive accurate figures reflecting the latest release phase and any applicable offers.
Jeddah vs Riyadh — which is better to buy property?
Amaya sits in a prime central location along King Abdulaziz Road, directly opposite the Red Sea Mall and minutes from the Jeddah Corniche. This gives buyers a coastal lifestyle address with direct connectivity to key urban and historic hubs.
What is the process for buying property in Jeddah?

title: Amaya
content:
Amaya offers full freehold ownership options for foreign buyers. Additionally, qualifying real estate investments at Amaya may enable eligible international buyers to apply for the Saudi Premium Residency.
What amenities are near Amaya?
In addition to nearby schools, medical clinics, and mosques, Amaya features signature community amenities. These include a 700-meter central parkland, shaded green walking trails, integrated retail courtyards, and the 4,000-square-meter members-only Vitality Club.

title: Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion
content:
Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion
16/11/2026
Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
Dar Global, the London-listed international luxury real estate developer, today announced plans for a new mixed-use development in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, with an estimated gross development value (GDV) of approximately SAR 1 billion (USD 267 million).
The project will be developed on land acquired for a consideration of approximately USD 56 million, further strengthening Dar Global's presence in one of Saudi Arabia's key real estate markets. The acquisition forms part of Dar Global's programme to expand its Saudi Arabia portfolio by up to SAR 4 billion, and further land acquisitions will be announced shortly. On completion of the programme, the company's global development pipeline is expected to reach approximately USD 24 billion.

title: Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion
content: The development is also set to introduce a new international luxury brand to Jeddah through an exclusive co-branded residential concept, further strengthening the city's luxury real estate offering. The expansion follows strong market demand for Dar Global's existing developments in Jeddah, including Trump Plaza and Padel Living, reflecting sustained appetite for high-quality, master-crafted residential and mixed-use developments among both local buyers and foreign investors taking advantage of the new property ownership laws.

title: Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion
content:
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, commented: “Saudi Arabia remains one of our most vital growth markets, and Jeddah continues to demonstrate exceptional fundamentals. The success of our existing developments reinforces our confidence in the market and underpins our commitment to delivering world-class residences in the Kingdom. With buyers from 61 nationalities already investing in our Saudi portfolio, we are witnessing accelerating international confidence in the country's real estate sector. This new development marks another significant milestone in our global expansion strategy.”
This expanding international participation highlights the Kingdom's rising appeal as a premier destination for global real estate capital, bolstered by comprehensive regulatory reforms and the transformative momentum of Saudi Vision 2030.

title: Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion
content:
Further details regarding the development, including its architectural concept, residential offerings, and official launch date, will be unveiled in due course.

title: Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate
content:
Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate
26/10/2026
Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP), the alternative asset management arm of London-listed luxury international developer Dar Global, today announced its strategic focus on deploying capital across international real estate markets through a dedicated cross-border mandate spanning the GCC, Europe, the United Kingdom, and the United States, alongside high-conviction investments in Dubai.
Operating independently from the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) under regulatory oversight by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA), DGCP connects global private wealth and institutional capital with prime real estate assets.

title: Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate
content: As part of this cross-border mandate, and with Dubai continuing to attract sustained international capital inflows as a premier wealth and business hub, DGCP is exploring the potential for a dedicated Dubai-focused real estate opportunities fund. The firm’s investment framework across all target markets is anchored in institutional discipline, prioritizing attractive entry valuations, rigorous structural downside protection, and active value creation through strategic asset repositioning and operational enhancements.

title: Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate
content: In parallel, DGCP announced the appointment of Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive Officer of Dar Global PLC, as Chairman of DGCP, reinforcing governance and alignment between the parent group’s international development footprint and the asset management platform. The appointment follows a transformational phase for Dar Global, which recently upgraded to the Equity Shares (Commercial Companies) category on the London Stock Exchange and expanded its global portfolio to $23 billion in Gross Development Value (GDV).

title: Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate
content:
“Through Dar Global, we built an international platform serving investors from more than 125 nationalities,” said Ziad El Chaar, Chairman of Dar Global Capital Partners and CEO of Dar Global. “With DGCP, we are taking the natural next step by establishing an institutional-grade, regulated vehicle that enables investors to access compelling cross-border real estate investments through a disciplined, value-oriented framework. While we pursue acquisitions across leading global gateway cities, Dubai’s exceptional fundamentals offer strong potential for targeted capital deployment.”
DGCP provides specialized asset management and advisory capabilities designed to create long-term value for sovereign, institutional, and ultra-high-net-worth investors across international jurisdictions.

Dar Global Opens Sales for Trump Villas Simaisma, Qatar with Unprecedented Interest
07/10/2026
Doha, Qatar
Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, has officially opened sales for its Trump Villas within Trump International Golf Club Simaisma, Qatar, witnessing unprecedented demand and strong investor interest since sales launched on 1 October.
The limited release includes three- and five-bedroom Trump Villas, each offering the privacy of a gated community, along with elevated views of the expansive 18-hole golf course, Simaisma beach and the open sea.
Residences are now available to purchase, with prices starting from QAR 5 million. Works on site are expected to begin in early 2027, with completion targeted for the end of 2030.

title: Dar Global Opens Sales for Trump Villas Simaisma, Qatar with Unprecedented Interest
content: Designed to deliver an exclusive coastal lifestyle, the development will be Doha’s first gated golf community, comprising a limited number of villas. It will feature a dedicated community centre for residents, equipped with padel and tennis courts, alongside a members-only golf and beach club, one of a kind worldwide.

title: Dar Global Opens Sales for Trump Villas Simaisma, Qatar with Unprecedented Interest
content:
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, commented: “The advancement of Trump International Simaisma, Qatar, marks a key milestone in delivering high-value, iconically branded real estate in premier regional growth markets. Beyond establishing a world-class championship golf and coastal destination, this project aligns directly with Qatar’s progressive foreign investment and property-linked residency frameworks, offering international investors long-term stability and 100% freehold ownership. Dar Global continues to provide global investors with a structured gateway to high-yielding, lifestyle-driven assets in the GCC.”
The destination offers buyers a rare opportunity to secure a residence within one of Qatar’s most ambitious new waterfront masterplans at an early stage.

title: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
content:
Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
30/09/2026
Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, recently announced its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HY 2026), reporting a 66% revenue increase to US$258.0 million (HY 2025: US$155.4 million). The performance was driven by the Group’s projects and sustained demand across its diversified portfolio in the GCC, Europe, and the UK.
Gross profit for the period rose 85% to US$87.7 million, expanding margins to 34% (from 31%). EBITDA increased 73% to US$46.3 million, while net profit surged 149% to US$30.4 million (HY 2025: US$12.2 million). Growth was primarily anchored by revenue recognition from landmark projects, including The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin and Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad.

title: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
content: The Group’s Gross Development Value (GDV) nearly doubled year-on-year to reach US$23.0 billion, reflecting rapid portfolio expansion. Cumulative contracted sales rose to US$3.9 billion across 4,380 units. Dar Global maintained a robust balance sheet with a Net Asset Value of US$613.3 million and total cash balances of US$847.9 million (comprising US$231.6 million free cash and US$616.3 million restricted escrow), supporting total available liquidity of US$579.3 million.

title: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
content: Operational momentum accelerated in Saudi Arabia with major project launches. In January, the Group partnered with The Trump Organization to launch Rayana, a 2.6 million sq. m gated community in Diriyah featuring luxury mansions and a championship golf course, followed by a SAR 338 million (~US$90 million) infrastructure contract award to Compass and Bin Omairah Company. Dar Global also unveiled Trump Plaza Jeddah (GDV US$383.6 million) and the adjacent Padel Living Residences (GDV US$142 million) within the Amaya masterplan.

title: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
content: Capital management and project execution remained key focus areas. In April, the Group strengthened its financial flexibility by closing a US$250 million syndicated term loan facility. Following the period in August, Dar Global appointed Gulf Asia Contracting to execute podium construction for the 80-storey, ~350-metre Trump International Hotel & Tower on Dubai's Sheikh Zayed Road.

title: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
content:
Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive, commented: “We have delivered a resilient performance through uncertain times in the region, supported by the quality of our international portfolio. Buyer demand across our markets remained robust, with cumulative contracted sales at 30 June 2026 of c. US$3.9 billion (Dec 2025 c. US$ 3.2 billion). During the period we closed our US$250 million facility, further strengthening our balance sheet and liquidity. Looking ahead, we remain focused on growing our Gross Development Value across both existing and new growth markets, while maintaining a disciplined focus on execution and delivery. With a strong balance sheet, disciplined capital management and a healthy project pipeline, Dar Global is well positioned to continue creating long-term value for its stakeholders.”

title: Dar Global Appoints Gulf Asia for Trump Tower Dubai
content:
Dar Global appoints Gulf Asia Contracting for Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai
06/08/2026
DUBAI, UAE
Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has awarded the construction contract to Gulf Asia Contracting for the podium of Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai. Following the successful completion of all enabling works, due in September 2026, this appointment marks the project's transition into the next stage of construction and another significant milestone in the delivery of one of Dubai's most anticipated luxury developments.
Located on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, the landmark development continues to progress on schedule as construction advances into its next phase. The appointment reinforces Dar Global's commitment to partnering with leading regional contractors to deliver exceptional quality across every stage of development.

title: Dar Global Appoints Gulf Asia for Trump Tower Dubai
content:
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, said: “Following the successful completion of our enabling works, we are pleased to appoint Gulf Asia Contracting to deliver the podium construction for Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai. This marks another important milestone as the project continues to progress according to plan and reflects our commitment to partnering with leading contractors to deliver exceptional quality throughout every stage of development.”
Introduced in April 2025, Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai is set to become a defining addition to Dubai's skyline. Rising approximately 350 metres across 80 floors, the development combines world-class hospitality, branded residences and an exclusive private members' club.

title: Dar Global Appoints Gulf Asia for Trump Tower Dubai
content:
Designed to set a new benchmark for luxury living, the tower will feature Dubai's highest outdoor swimming pool, two signature penthouses inspired by New York's iconic Trump Tower on Fifth Avenue, and uninterrupted views across Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai and the Arabian Gulf.
The latest construction milestone reflects the continued momentum of the project as Dar Global advances the development in line with its delivery programme.

title: Dar Global & Fendi Casa Announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman
content:
Dar Global and Fendi Casa announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman
29/06/2026
Muscat, Oman
Dar Global  and FENDI Casa announce the launch of Azure Oceanfront Villas, a collection of ultra-luxury mansions with interiors by FENDI Casa, set within the prestigious AIDA clifftop community in Muscat, Oman. Conceived by Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate company, AIDA is one of the most expansive and exclusive mixed-use real estate developments globally.
The launch unveils 19 thoughtfully designed and exquisitely appointed mansions with direct beach access featuring FENDI Casa's signature Italian craftsmanship and refined high-end design to AIDA, a magnificent, gated community built on a 130-metre-high cliff, surrounded by rocky canyons, pristine beaches, and the scenic Oman coastline.

title: Dar Global & Fendi Casa Announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman
content: Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, said: “The launch of Azure Oceanfront Villas, Interiors by FENDI Casa, at AIDA reflects Dar Global’s commitment to identifying and unlocking high-value real estate opportunities in growth markets. Oman’s luxury property sector is at a turning point, fuelled by investor appetite for branded residences and government initiatives driving inbound investment. Our partnership with FENDI Casa brings world-renowned Italian design to this vision, elevating the standard of upscale living in Muscat. Together, we are further elevating the position of  AIDA as a strategic gateway for global investors seeking long-term value, lifestyle returns, and design-led distinction in the region.”

title: Dar Global & Fendi Casa Announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman
content: Positioned on an expansive site with unobstructed sea views, Azure Oceanfront Villas, with interiors by FENDI Casa, offers exceptional privacy and seclusion for a select group of discerning residents. The distinctly modern mansions embody the essence of seaside living, evoking a tranquil and luxurious sanctuary. With spacious floor plans, each villa includes private amenities such as an outdoor pool and a state-of-the-art gym. Beautifully furnished, the homes reflect FENDI Casa's renowned blend of elegance and contemporary style, with curated attention to details, materials, and artisanal craftsmanship.

title: Dar Global & Fendi Casa Announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman
content: This elegant new landmark within AIDA marks the first collaboration between Dar Global and FENDI Casa on a high-end residential project. The unveiling also represents a significant milestone for Oman as Azure Oceanfront Villas, Interiors by FENDI Casa, becomes the first development in the Sultanate to feature interiors by the design brand of a luxury fashion Maison.

title: Dar Global & Fendi Casa Announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman
content:
Spanning over 4.3 million sqm and targeting international investors and buyers, AIDA blends nature, luxury, and lifestyle, boasting world-class hotels, an 18-hole golf course, an exclusive members-only club, and a bouquet of residential offerings including upscale villas and apartments. Centrally located in the Omani capital, within a short distance of Muscat International Airport and Central Downtown, this significant urban development in Oman is enhancing the country's global stature as a compelling destination for tourists, residents, and investors alike.

DarGlobal Awards SAR 338 Million Rayana Master Community Infrastructure Contract To Compass And Bin Omairah In Wadi Safar, Diriyah, Riyadh
18/06/2026
Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has awarded a SAR 338 million infrastructure contract for its ultra-exclusive Rayana community in Wadi Safar, Riyadh, to Compass and Bin Omairah Company for Contracting LLC
The award marks a major milestone in the development of Rayana and reflects DarGlobal's continued progress in delivering one of Saudi Arabia's most prestigious residential destinations. The design-and-build contract covers the delivery of the primary infrastructure works supporting the Rayana community, including earthworks, roads, utility networks and access infrastructure across the development.

title: DarGlobal Awards SAR 338 Million Rayana Infrastructure Contract in Wadi Safar, Diriyah
content: Located within Wadi Safar, one of the most exclusive districts of Diriyah, Rayana has been carefully designed as a low-density residential enclave that prioritises privacy, space and a seamless connection with the surrounding natural landscape. The infrastructure works will establish the foundations for the community's luxury residential offering, including Rayana Mansions and the branded Trump Mansions. The community's signature Rayana Mansions and branded Trump Mansions feature expansive residences with built-up areas ranging from approximately 1,900 sqm to 7,000 sqm.

title: DarGlobal Awards SAR 338 Million Rayana Infrastructure Contract in Wadi Safar, Diriyah
content: Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive Officer of DarGlobal, said: "The award of this infrastructure contract represents an important step forward in the delivery of Rayana and reinforces our commitment to creating exceptional residential destinations in Saudi Arabia. As one of the most exclusive communities within Wadi Safar and the world, Rayana has been conceived around privacy, scale and a highly curated lifestyle experience. This milestone demonstrates the continued momentum of the project and our confidence in the long-term growth of the Kingdom's luxury real estate sector."

title: DarGlobal Awards SAR 338 Million Rayana Infrastructure Contract in Wadi Safar, Diriyah
content:
The milestone further supports Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 objectives by contributing to the development of world-class residential destinations that attract local and international investment. Positioned within Wadi Safar, Rayana offers residents access to one of Riyadh's most sought-after lifestyle destinations, in close proximity to Diriyah, the King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD), Expo 2030 and the city's future growth corridors.

title: DarGlobal Marks Five Years of Global Expansion with $23 Billion Real Estate Portfolio
content:
DarGlobal marks five years of global expansion with $23bln development portfolio and a bold vision for the future
16/06/2026
Saudi Arabia
Since launching its first project in Dubai in 2021, DarGlobal has expanded across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, Qatar, Spain, Greece and the United Kingdom
DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, is marking its fifth anniversary following a period of rapid international expansion that has transformed the company into a USD 23 billion global real estate platform serving investors from more than 125 nationalities.
Since launching its first project in Dubai in 2021, DarGlobal has expanded across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, Qatar, Spain, Greece and the United Kingdom, establishing a diversified portfolio of luxury residential, hospitality and lifestyle destinations.

title: DarGlobal Marks Five Years of Global Expansion with $23 Billion Real Estate Portfolio
content: The milestone follows a transformational year for the company. In FY2025, DarGlobal tripled its Gross Development Value from USD 7.5 billion in FY2024 to USD 23 billion, reflecting the scale and quality of the pipeline it has built across global markets, including five major master-planned communities and a growing portfolio of globally recognised branded residences. Revenue increased by 124% to USD 539 million, while EBITDA reached a record USD 126 million, reflecting strong operational performance and sustained demand across its international portfolio. Today, the company has approximately 6,100 units under construction across 16 projects and maintains a strong financial position, supported by USD 702 million in cash and cash equivalents as of December 2025, alongside a recently secured USD 250 million financing facility to support future growth.

title: DarGlobal Marks Five Years of Global Expansion with $23 Billion Real Estate Portfolio
content: Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive Officer of DarGlobal, said: "Over the last five years, we have built a company designed for global citizens, investors who increasingly live, work and invest across multiple countries. What began as a luxury real estate developer has evolved into a diversified platform spanning real estate, hospitality, golf, private clubs, asset management and emerging real estate technologies, developed alongside some of the world's most recognised brands. As we look ahead, our ambition is not simply to build homes, but to create destinations, experiences and ecosystems that define the future of luxury living."

title: DarGlobal Marks Five Years of Global Expansion with $23 Billion Real Estate Portfolio
content:
As part of its next phase of growth, DarGlobal has expanded into hospitality and entertainment, with luxury hotels under development in Dubai, Riyadh and Muscat. The company is also building a portfolio of golf destinations and private members' clubs across key international markets. In parallel, DarGlobal has launched DarGlobal Capital Partners, its asset management platform, while advancing initiatives in real estate tokenization as part of its strategy to participate in the future evolution of global real estate investment.
Another defining element of the company's growth has been its partnerships with some of the world's most recognised luxury brands, including The Trump Organization, Automobili Lamborghini, Aston Martin, Pagani, FENDI, ELIE SAAB, Missoni, Mouawad, Marriott Residences, W Hotels and Nickelodeon Hotels and Resorts.

title: DarGlobal Marks Five Years of Global Expansion with $23 Billion Real Estate Portfolio
content:
The company recently became the first GCC-based business to be upgraded to the ESCC category of the London Stock Exchange, reflecting its commitment to international governance standards and transparency. Looking ahead, DarGlobal plans to deepen its focus on asset management, hospitality and technology-enabled real estate solutions while progressing major master communities in Muscat, Riyadh, Jeddah, Southern Spain, with an additional large-scale community planned in Greece.
"We believe we are only at the beginning of our growth journey," El Chaar added. "Our ambition is to continue building one of the world's leading real estate platforms for global citizens while creating long-term value for our investors, partners and customers."

title: Emirates NBD Executes $250M Loan for Darglobal Expansion UAE
content:
Emirates NBD successfully executes USD 250 Million Syndicated Term Loan facility for Darglobal, Accelerating Global Growth and Expansion
16/04/2026
Dubai, UAE
Emirates NBD, a leading banking group in the Middle East, North Africa and Türkiye (MENAT) region, has announced the successful execution of a USD 250 million syndicated term loan facility (“Project Radium II”) for Darglobal plc, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer. Darglobal plc secured this USD 250 million financing as part of its continued growth and expansion across key global markets.

title: Emirates NBD Executes $250M Loan for Darglobal Expansion UAE
content:
Emirates NBD Capital acted as the Joint Mandated Lead Arranger, Bookrunner and Sole Documentation Agent to execute the USD 250 million deal. The financing will support Darglobal's global expansion plans, enabling the leading real estate developer to accelerate existing projects and pursue new property developments across key markets.
This financing highlights Emirates NBD’s structuring and distribution capabilities in the syndicated finance space, reinforcing its role as a trusted partner to regional and international real estate developers amid sustained momentum in global property markets.

title: Emirates NBD Executes $250M Loan for Darglobal Expansion UAE
content: Ahmed Al Qassim, Group Head of Wholesale Banking at Emirates NBD, said: "This transaction reinforces the confidence global institutions place in Emirates NBD's ability to originate and execute large-scale syndicated financings. The strong participation from a broad group of lenders reflects deep distribution across our network and continued appetite for real estate-linked credit. We are pleased to have structured a facility that aligns with Darglobal's business ambitions, underlining our commitment to delivering tailored financing solutions that support the sustained growth of the luxury real estate sector across key global markets."

title: Emirates NBD Executes $250M Loan for Darglobal Expansion UAE
content:
This deal underscores Emirates NBD's central role in structuring and delivering the facility, with the Bank driving the documentation process through to a timely and successful close. The financing, executed in coordination with other regional banks, is structured to provide Darglobal with flexibility to support its funding requirements and future growth plans.
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Darglobal, said: “This facility, structured with Emirates NBD, brings together a strong group of financial institutions supporting Darglobal’s continued growth. It enhances our liquidity and provides the flexibility to advance our existing developments while maintaining a disciplined and selective approach to new opportunities.
As a London-listed platform with a global portfolio, access to diversified funding sources remains central to our strategy as we scale across key international markets.”

title: Emirates NBD Executes $250M Loan for Darglobal Expansion UAE
content:
As a leading banking group in syndicated finance with a demonstrated expertise in the real estate sector, Emirates NBD continues its commitment to supporting the growth and international ambitions of its clients through its tailored financing solutions.

title: DarGlobal & Art District Reveal MAD: Muscat’s Marine, Art & Digital District | USD 4.2B Coastal Mega Development
content:
DarGlobal and Art District Real Estate Development Announce MAD, Muscat’s Marine, Art & Digital District
04/12/2025
Muscat, Oman

title: DarGlobal & Art District Reveal MAD: Muscat’s Marine, Art & Digital District | USD 4.2B Coastal Mega Development
content: DarGlobal (LSE: DAR), the London-listed luxury real estate developer, in partnership with Art District Real Estate Development, today announced the start of the collaboration to launch and develop MAD, Muscat Marine, Art & Digital District, a transformative new coastal destination that integrates oceanfront living, luxury hospitality, culture-led enterprise, and future-focused finance and digital industries. Located along Oman’s picturesque coastline, the MAD project spans over 1.5 million square meters with a gross development value of approximately OMR 1.6 billion (USD 4.2 Billion) for all development phases which will span over 12 years. It is designed to elevate the Sultanate’s global standing by merging sea-view living, luxury hospitality, cultural expression, and future financial and digital sectors into one unified ecosystem.

title: DarGlobal & Art District Reveal MAD: Muscat’s Marine, Art & Digital District | USD 4.2B Coastal Mega Development
content:
Conceived as a multi-destination city, MAD brings together luxury residential communities, cultural venues, world-class marinas, curated retail, next-generation finance and business parks, and premium hotels. The district will invite affluent travelers, global investors, art collectors, tech founders and creative entrepreneurs to live, work and connect within a single, seamless experience rooted in Oman’s maritime identity and economic vision.
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of DarGlobal, said: “MAD represents a defining step in how Oman’s coastline will be experienced and how its future economy will emerge. Together with Art District Real Estate development, we are building a destination that goes beyond real estate to empower enterprise, attract global talent, support cultural production and unlock new economic value. MAD is a new gateway for Oman, one inspired by the sea and shaped by innovation.”

title: DarGlobal & Art District Reveal MAD: Muscat’s Marine, Art & Digital District | USD 4.2B Coastal Mega Development
content:
At the heart of MAD is a commitment to support Oman’s diversification goals, aligning with the nation’s strategy to grow culture, tourism, technology and high-value finance and investment sectors. The district will host private marinas for mansions, international art exhibitions, digital incubators, a financial center, and a cultural calendar of global events, positioning Muscat as a hub for marine adventure, cultural exchange and financial and digital creativity.
This project reflects Oman’s confidence in building industries of the future. MAD showcases how strategic development can preserve our maritime heritage while embracing the opportunities of global innovation. It will attract investment, cultivate talent, and create enduring cultural and economic impact for generations to come.”

title: DarGlobal & Art District Reveal MAD: Muscat’s Marine, Art & Digital District | USD 4.2B Coastal Mega Development
content:
A defining feature of MAD is the integration of a district-wide digital economy, enabling a new model of property, culture, and enterprise. The development introduces digital licensing, asset exchange, and ecosystem rewards, supporting business formation and investment pathways for global entrepreneurs and investors.
“We are creating value beyond physical spaces,” added El Chaar. “MAD is an ecosystem where creators, innovators and investors meet; not only to live or visit, but to participate. That participation defines the future of real estate, and we are proud to shape it in Oman.This partnership demonstrates what Oman stands for; cultural leadership, responsible innovation and global investment confidence. MAD is a testament to what is possible when heritage and ambition come together.”

DarGlobal appoints Al Dahlawi Company for Contracting, LLC, to deliver main works at Amaya, Jeddah’s “Beverly Hills” in the making, home to Trump Plaza Jeddah.
23/04/2026
Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has appointed Al Dahlawi Company for Contracting as the contractor to deliver works at Amaya, its flagship masterplan development in Jeddah. This appointment marks a key milestone in advancing the integrated urban district, which spans approximately one million square meters in one of the city’s most strategically connected locations.

Strategically located along King Abdulaziz Road, one of Jeddah’s most sought-after and established corridors, Amaya occupies a rare and highly coveted position in the city. title: DarGlobal Appoints Al Dahlawi for Amaya Jeddah, Home to Trump Plaza

The appointment of the main contractor reflects DarGlobal’s continued commitment to advancing its developments in line with established timelines, while contributing to the evolution of Jeddah as a global destination for investment, business, and modern urban living.

title: Darglobal Reports 17.3% ROE for FY2025 | Luxury Real Estate Growth
content:
Darglobal delivers industry-leading 17.3% ROE in 2025, Strengthened position for evolving market conditions
31/03/2026
Dubai, UAE
Further to the Full Year Results for 2025 issued on 11 March 2026, Darglobal, the luxury international real estate developer, reports a Return on Equity ('ROE') of 17.3% for the financial year ended 31 December 2025 ('FY25'). This performance places the Group among the highest-returning listed developers in the UK and Europe.
The result reflects the strength of Darglobal's model: a geographically diversified portfolio combined with an asset-light approach that enables disciplined capital deployment while limiting balance sheet exposure.

title: Darglobal Reports 17.3% ROE for FY2025 | Luxury Real Estate Growth
content:
This model has supported rapid scaling, with the Group's portfolio reaching approximately US$23 billion in GDV, alongside continued expansion into key markets, the launch of new development platforms, and the introduction of asset management capabilities.
Importantly, this performance positions Darglobal to navigate a more uncertain and demanding market environment ahead, with the flexibility, liquidity, and execution discipline required to continue delivering value.

title: Darglobal Reports 17.3% ROE for FY2025 | Luxury Real Estate Growth
content:
Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive Officer of Darglobal, said: " We are reporting a sector-leading ROE of 17.3%, reflecting the strength of our strategy and execution. Over the past year, we have scaled the business to a portfolio of US$23 billion in GDV, while maintaining financial discipline and operational efficiency. These results are not only a reflection of past performance, but a clear indication that Darglobal is well-positioned for the market conditions ahead. Our model gives us the flexibility to adapt, the resilience to withstand volatility, and the ability to continue creating long-term value for our stakeholders."

title: DarGlobal Strengthens China Partnerships as Saudi Real Estate Opens to Global Investors
content:
DarGlobal Strengthens China Partnerships as Saudi Real Estate Market Opens to Global Investors
12/02/2026
Beijing, Shenzhen
DarGlobal, the international luxury real estate developer listed on the London Stock Exchange, has concluded a high-level strategic engagement in China, reinforcing its commitment to expanding cross-border investment partnerships as Saudi Arabia's real estate market opens to foreign non-resident investors.
The delegation held senior-level meetings across Beijing, Shenzhen, and Shanghai with leading real estate developers, engineering groups, and contracting partners, focused on advancing collaboration aligned with the Kingdom's ongoing economic transformation. As Saudi Arabia's largest trading partner, China represents a natural strategic counterpart as international capital gains greater access to the Saudi property market.

title: DarGlobal Strengthens China Partnerships as Saudi Real Estate Opens to Global Investors
content:
Discussions centred on potential investment participation in Saudi Arabia's newly accessible real estate sector, alongside reciprocal opportunities for strategic cooperation within China. The engagements underscored strong mutual interest in long-term partnerships that connect Chinese expertise and capital with high-growth developments across the Kingdom.
A key highlight of the visit was DarGlobal's engagement around the Hainan Free Trade Port (FTP), now operating as a full-scale customs zone with island-wide special customs operations and expanded zero-tariff treatment for goods and services. The FTP offers a highly competitive regulatory and tax environment designed to attract global investment and accelerate Hainan's emergence as a leading international trade and economic hub.

title: DarGlobal Strengthens China Partnerships as Saudi Real Estate Opens to Global Investors
content:
DarGlobal explored opportunities to participate in select high-potential projects in Hainan Province, leveraging the FTP's preferential policies to create property-linked investment opportunities for its global investor base spanning more than 115 nationalities.
Commenting on the outcome of the mission, Ziad El Chaar, CEO of DarGlobal, said: "Our engagement in China reflects DarGlobal's long-term strategy to build meaningful partnerships with global markets that share our outlook on growth, scale, and opportunity. The strong interest we encountered across Beijing, Shenzhen, and Shanghai highlights the alignment between China's investment ambitions and the unprecedented momentum unfolding in Saudi Arabia's real estate sector."

title: DarGlobal Strengthens China Partnerships as Saudi Real Estate Opens to Global Investors
content:
DarGlobal will build on these discussions by advancing select partnerships and joint initiatives that leverage the complementary strengths of both markets, supporting increased investment flows and cross-border collaboration.

content:
DarGlobal and The Trump Organisation Expand Saudi Portfolio With Usd 1BN Trump Plaza Jeddah
12/01/2026
Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
- New landmark mixed-use district to deliver Grade-A offices, premium retail, destination dining, a members-only lifestyle club, and Trump residences within the Amaya development.
- All components unified around a private central park, creating a fully integrated urban ecosystem.
- Project marks the third strategic collaboration between Dar Global and The Trump Organization in Saudi Arabia’s rapidly evolving real estate market.

title: DarGlobal and The Trump Organisation Expand Saudi Portfolio With Usd 1BN Trump Plaza Jeddah
content:
Dar Global (LSE: DAR), the London-listed international luxury real estate developer, announced today the official launch of Trump Plaza Jeddah, marking its third prestigious collaboration with The Trump Organization in Saudi Arabia. Valued at over USD 1 billion, this landmark development, strategically located within the expansive Amaya development along King Abdulaziz Road, is poised to redefine luxury urban living in Jeddah’s thriving real estate landscape, following the successful launch of Trump Tower Jeddah in December 2024.
Trump Plaza Jeddah is envisioned as ‘Jeddah’s Most Connected Address’, offering a fully integrated mixed-use destination for the discerning global citizen, seamlessly bringing together residences, offices, retail, and dining within a single, connected address.

title: DarGlobal and The Trump Organisation Expand Saudi Portfolio With Usd 1BN Trump Plaza Jeddah
content: Residential offerings include fully furnished 1, 2, and 3-bedroom Trump Executive Residences; premium 2, 3, and 4-bedroom Trump Park Residences; and exclusive 4-bedroom Trump Townhouses. Together with thoughtfully designed home offices, premium retail, and curated dining, the project redefines modern living by blending convenience and luxury into a single, connected destination. Optional rental management services further enhance the appeal for international owners seeking a turnkey ownership experience.

title: DarGlobal and The Trump Organisation Expand Saudi Portfolio With Usd 1BN Trump Plaza Jeddah
content:
Eric Trump, Executive Vice President of The Trump Organization, commented: “Expanding our presence in Saudi Arabia with Trump Plaza Jeddah underscores our commitment to world-class quality and iconic design. This project reflects the strength of our relationship with Dar Global and our confidence in Jeddah as a dynamic, globally relevant city. Trump Plaza Jeddah will set a new benchmark for integrated urban destinations.”
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, added: “The launch of Trump Plaza Jeddah represents a major milestone in our Saudi portfolio. This is not a single-use development, but a carefully curated urban ecosystem designed for global residents who want to live, work, and connect within the best address in Jeddah. Anchored by a private park and supported by world-class amenities, Trump Plaza Jeddah introduces a new model for modern city living in the Kingdom.”

title: DarGlobal and The Trump Organisation Expand Saudi Portfolio With Usd 1BN Trump Plaza Jeddah
content:
Central to this lifestyle offering is the exclusive 4,000-square-metre members-only Vitality Club, featuring golf simulators, a spa, sports medicine and recovery facilities, swimming pools, fine dining, a cigar & library lounge, coffee bar, and high-performance wellness spaces. These are complemented by destination retail and dining concepts, including Trump Grill, Trump Daily, an artisan bakery, and a fitness pro shop, reinforcing the project’s positioning as a district that operates seamlessly day and night.
Located at the heart of the 1,000,000-square-metre Amaya development, Trump Plaza Jeddah anchors a new, highly integrated urban district that reflects the Kingdom’s growing prominence as a global real estate destination, supported by foreign-ownership incentives, a 0% capital gains tax, and accelerated infrastructure investment.

title: DarGlobal Awards Enabling Works Contract for Trump Tower Dubai
content:
DarGlobal Awards Enabling Works Contract for Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai to Edrafor Emirates LLC
10/12/2025
Dubai, UAE
DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has awarded the enabling works contract for the Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai to Edrafor Emirates LLC, marking a key milestone in advancing construction of this landmark development on Sheikh Zayed Road at the entrance of Downtown Dubai.

title: DarGlobal Awards Enabling Works Contract for Trump Tower Dubai
content:
Introduced in April this year, Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai is set to become a new global icon, bringing together world-class hospitality, luxury residential living, and The Trump – an exclusive members-only private club designed for a select community of discerning global residents. The 80-floor tower will stand 350 metres high and feature Dubai’s highest outdoor pool, two ultra-rare penthouses inspired by New York’s Trump Tower on Fifth Avenue, and sweeping panoramic views of Burj Khalifa.

title: Top 7 Art Museums in Dubai | DarGlobal
content:
Exploring Dubai’s Art Scene: The 7 Best Art Museums
Dubai, a city known for its architectural marvels and luxurious lifestyle, is also a burgeoning hub for art enthusiasts. The city’s vibrant art scene is reflected in its array of museums, each offering a unique perspective on regional and international art. Here’s a guide to the seven best art museums in Dubai that are a must-visit for art lovers.
1. Louvre Abu Dhabi
While technically not in Dubai, the Louvre Abu Dhabi is a cultural beacon worth the short trip. This universal museum in the Arab world focuses on shared human stories across civilizations and cultures. Designed by Jean Nouvel, the museum’s architecture is a work of art in itself, with a mesmerizing dome that creates a rain of light effect.
2. Dubai Museum

title: Top 7 Art Museums in Dubai | DarGlobal
content:
Housed in the Al Fahidi Fort, the Dubai Museum is a deep dive into the emirate’s rich history and culture. The museum showcases life in Dubai before the oil boom, offering insights into the local art and cultural heritage. It’s a perfect blend of historical and contemporary artistry.
3. Etihad Museum
The Etihad Museum, with its stunning design resembling a manuscript, offers a glimpse into the United Arab Emirates’ formation. It’s a modern museum focusing on contemporary creations, featuring interactive pavilions where visitors can explore the UAE’s history through photos, films, and more.
4. Jameel Arts Centre
As one of the contemporary art institutions in Dubai, Jameel Arts Centre is a platform for contemporary artists and cultural events. It hosts multiple galleries, a research library, and a garden of sculptures, making it a vibrant cultural destination.
5. Tashkeel

title: Top 7 Art Museums in Dubai | DarGlobal
content:
Tashkeel is an independent resource for artists and designers living and working in the UAE. It offers studios, workshops, and a gallery space. The exhibitions here are dynamic, featuring everything from local to international works, across all mediums of visual art.
6. The Third Line
The Third Line is a Dubai-based gallery that showcases contemporary Middle Eastern artists. With a focus on promoting local art and artists, the gallery often hosts thought-provoking exhibitions and is a key player in the local art scene.
7. Leila Heller Gallery
Located in Alserkal Avenue, Leila Heller Gallery is known for its engagement with artists from the Middle East, Central Asia, Southeast Asia, and Turkey. The gallery hosts a variety of exhibitions, often featuring large-scale installations and public projects.

title: Top 7 Art Museums in Dubai | DarGlobal
content:
In Dubai, the art scene is as diverse as the city itself, offering everything from historical insights to contemporary artistic expressions. These seven museums and galleries are just the beginning of what Dubai has to offer to art aficionados. Each visit promises a new perspective, showcasing why Dubai is rapidly becoming a global art destination.

It’s not just about luxury anymore; it’s about integrating that luxury with functionality to cater to the new-age professional lifestyle. In our latest feature, we delve into the trends and tips that remote professionals should consider when buying a home in the digital era.
Embrace the Smart Home Revolution:

title: Home Buying in the Digital Age: Trends and Tips for Remote Professionals
content:
In the age of IoT (Internet of Things), smart homes are more than a luxury; they are a necessity. For remote professionals, a home equipped with smart technology offers unparalleled convenience. Look for properties with integrated smart systems for security, climate control, and home automation. These features not only enhance your living experience but also increase the property’s value.
Prioritize High-Speed Connectivity:
A fast and reliable internet connection is the lifeline of remote work. When house hunting, consider the internet infrastructure of the area. Some luxury real estate developers are now offering built-in high-speed internet solutions as part of their package, recognizing its importance for today’s buyers.
Seek Out Functional Workspaces:

title: Home Buying in the Digital Age: Trends and Tips for Remote Professionals
content:
An ideal home for a remote professional should have a dedicated workspace. This space should be quiet, well-lit, and ideally separate from the main living areas. Properties with an extra room or a convertible space that can be turned into an office are highly sought after.
Location Still Matters:
Even if your work is location-independent, the location of your home is crucial. Look for properties in neighborhoods that offer a good mix of tranquility and accessibility to urban conveniences. Proximity to airports, dining, and leisure facilities is also a plus for the jet-setting remote professional.
Consider Community Amenities:

title: Home Buying in the Digital Age: Trends and Tips for Remote Professionals

Luxury real estate communities often come with amenities that can greatly enhance your work-life balance. Facilities like fitness centers, pools, and recreational areas offer the perfect escape from a busy work schedule. These amenities not only provide relaxation but also opportunities for networking with like-minded individuals.
Think Long-Term and Resale Value:
When investing in a property, consider its long-term value and potential resale worth. Properties in developing areas, sustainable homes, and those with unique architectural designs often appreciate better over time.

title: Home Buying in the Digital Age: Trends and Tips for Remote Professionals

In conclusion, for remote professionals in the digital age, buying a home is not just a financial decision, but also a lifestyle choice. It’s about finding a place that resonates with your professional needs while providing the luxury and comfort you deserve. With these trends and tips, we aim to guide you towards making an informed decision in your home-buying journey. Remember, in the world of luxury real estate, your home is not just where you live; it’s where you thrive.

title: Top 5 Insurance Coverage for Homeowners | DarGlobal
content:
Five Types of Insurance Coverage Every Homeowner Needs
Owning a home is a significant achievement and a substantial investment that necessitates protection. As a homeowner, it’s crucial to understand the various types of insurance coverage available to safeguard your property and finances. Here are five essential types of insurance coverage every homeowner should consider:
1. Homeowners Insurance
This is the most fundamental and necessary form of insurance for homeowners. It covers the structure of your home, your personal belongings, and liability protection in case someone is injured on your property. Homeowners insurance typically covers damage from fires, storms, theft, and other common hazards. However, it’s important to read the fine print, as certain natural disasters like floods and earthquakes are often not covered.
2. Flood Insurance

title: Top 5 Insurance Coverage for Homeowners | DarGlobal
content:
Standard homeowners insurance policies do not cover flood damage. If your home is in a flood-prone area, flood insurance is indispensable. This insurance covers damage to your home’s structure and belongings due to flooding. The National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) and private insurers provide this coverage, which can be a lifesaver in safeguarding your investment against unpredictable natural disasters.
3. Earthquake Insurance
Similar to flood insurance, earthquake insurance is a must-have if you live in an area prone to earthquakes. This coverage helps repair or rebuild your home and replace personal belongings in the event of an earthquake. Considering the devastating impact an earthquake can have, this insurance provides essential financial protection.
4. Umbrella Liability Insurance

title: Top 5 Insurance Coverage for Homeowners | DarGlobal
content:
Umbrella liability insurance provides additional liability coverage beyond what your standard homeowners insurance offers. It protects your assets and future earnings in case you’re sued for damages that exceed the liability limits of your other insurance policies. It’s particularly valuable for homeowners with significant assets or potential exposure to liability claims.
5. Home Warranty or Home Repair Insurance
While not traditional insurance, a home warranty or home repair insurance can be a wise investment. This coverage typically pays for the repair or replacement of major home systems and appliances that break down over time. It’s a practical way to manage unexpected repair costs and ensure that your home remains in good working order.

title: Top 5 Insurance Coverage for Homeowners | DarGlobal
content:
In summary, while homeownership is a source of pride, it also comes with risks. By investing in the right insurance coverages, you can protect your home, belongings, and financial well-being against unforeseen events. Each homeowner’s needs are unique, so it’s advisable to consult with an insurance professional to tailor a package that suits your specific situation.

content:
Staying Up-To-Speed on the Latest Residential Design Trends for 2024
As we step into 2024, the world of residential design continues to evolve, reflecting changes in technology, lifestyle, and aesthetics. For homeowners, designers, and enthusiasts alike, keeping abreast of these trends is crucial for creating spaces that are both contemporary and comfortable. Let’s explore some of the anticipated trends for 2024 and how to stay informed about the latest in residential design.
Anticipated Trends for 2024:
Sustainable and Eco-Friendly Designs: Sustainability is more than a buzzword in 2024; it’s a necessity. Expect to see an increase in eco-friendly materials, energy-efficient designs, and homes that focus on reducing carbon footprints. This includes the use of recycled materials, solar panels, and designs that maximize natural light and ventilation.

title: Staying Up-To-Speed on the Latest Residential Design Trends for 2024 - DarGlobal
content:
Smart Home Integration: As technology advances, so does the integration of smart home technology in residential design. From automated lighting and heating systems to advanced security and entertainment setups, homes in 2024 are expected to be more connected and intelligent than ever.
Minimalist Aesthetics: The minimalist trend continues to dominate, with a focus on clean lines, neutral colors, and uncluttered spaces. This design philosophy not only creates a visually appealing space but also promotes a sense of calm and simplicity.
Multifunctional Spaces: With the rise of remote work and home-based activities, multifunctional spaces are becoming increasingly important. Rooms that can double as home offices, gyms, or recreational areas are a key trend for 2024.

title: Staying Up-To-Speed on the Latest Residential Design Trends for 2024 - DarGlobal
content:
Biophilic Design Elements: Incorporating natural elements into home design not only enhances aesthetic appeal but also promotes well-being. Expect to see more indoor plants, natural light, and the use of natural materials like wood and stone
To stay informed, you can do the following below:
Follow Industry Experts and Design Influencers: Social media platforms and design blogs are great resources. Follow industry leaders and influencers for regular updates and insights.
Attend Design Expos and Trade Shows: These events showcase the latest innovations and trends in the industry. They provide a firsthand look at new materials, technologies, and design concepts.
Subscribe to Design Magazines and Journals: Publications like Architectural Digest, Elle Decor, and others are excellent sources for the latest trends and design ideas.

title: Staying Up-To-Speed on the Latest Residential Design Trends for 2024 - DarGlobal
content:
Participate in Online Forums and Webinars: Engaging in discussions with other design enthusiasts and professionals can provide valuable insights and tips.
Experiment and Innovate: Finally, don’t be afraid to experiment with new ideas in your own space. Sometimes the best way to stay ahead is to be a trendsetter yourself.
In conclusion, the residential design trends of 2024 are marked by a blend of technology, sustainability, and aesthetics. By engaging with the design community, attending events, and keeping an open mind to new ideas, you can stay up-to-speed with the latest trends and incorporate them into your living spaces.

title: ROI & ROE in Real Estate Co-Branding | Ziad El Chaar Insights
content:
High ROI and ROE, Real Estate Co-branding through the Lens of Ziad El Chaar, CEO of DarGlobal
From Gianni Versace's Vision to Modern-Day Success, Co-Branding Redefines Exclusive Property Developments.

title: ROI & ROE in Real Estate Co-Branding | Ziad El Chaar Insights
content:
In the realm of real estate, co-branding has emerged as a potent strategy that combines the allure of fashion and luxury brands with exclusive property developments. This trend originated in the early 1980s when fashion events paved the way for collaborative initiatives. One of the pioneering figures in this field was the legendary Gianni Versace, who introduced the concept of fashion brand interiors in hotels and mansions. Today, co-branding between real estate and renowned fashion brands has become increasingly prevalent, offering significant value to clients, developers, and the brands involved. In this article, we delve into the insights of Ziad El Chaar, the CEO of DarGlobal, a prominent figure in the real estate industry, as he explores the benefits and impact of co-branding in this domain.
Offering Clients Ultimate Exclusivity in the Digital Age

title: ROI & ROE in Real Estate Co-Branding | Ziad El Chaar Insights
content:
In the digital age, our lives have become increasingly public, with social media platforms dominating our daily interactions. Influencers, who shape consumer preferences, have emerged, creating a desire for exclusivity among the masses. Ziad El Chaar emphasizes that co-branded real estate projects cater to this desire, presenting clients with limited edition properties. The exclusivity associated with these collaborations not only offers a high return on investment but also satisfies clients’ innate longing for distinction. By owning an exclusive property associated with a prestigious brand, individuals can fulfill their ego-driven aspirations, feeling part of an elite group.
Enabling Developers to offer trust and exclusivity

title: ROI & ROE in Real Estate Co-Branding | Ziad El Chaar Insights
content:
For developers, co-branding brings multiple advantages. First and foremost, it conveys trustworthiness and readibility to potential buyers. Collaborating with well-known brands allows developers to leverage the brand’s reputation and established presence, assuring clients of the project’s quality. Additionally, co-branding enables developers to infuse a sense of exclusivity into large-scale projects. Rather than simply offering a multitude of units, the limited-edition aspect associated with a renowned brand elevates the project’s desirability and allure. This exclusivity contributes to higher returns on investment and increased client interest.
Allowing Branding Partners to deepen their connections

title: ROI & ROE in Real Estate Co-Branding | Ziad El Chaar Insights
content:
From the perspective of the co-branding partner, which is typically a fashion or luxury brand, there are numerous benefits to be gained. Engaging in a co-branded real estate project often involves a substantial revenue opportunity, given the high value associated with such developments. However, beyond financial gains, Ziad El Chaar highlights the importance of immersing clients in the brand experience. When individuals reside in a property associated with a particular brand, they form a deeper connection with the brand itself. This enhanced connection allows brands to strengthen their relationship with clients, fostering loyalty and long-term brand engagement.
Key Considerations for Successful Co-Branding

title: ROI & ROE in Real Estate Co-Branding | Ziad El Chaar Insights
content:
While co-branding has seen significant growth in recent years, it requires careful consideration and strategic implementation. Merely placing a brand’s stamp on a property is insufficient. Ziad El Chaar emphasizes the importance of aligning the brand’s DNA with the project’s interiors and architecture. By seamlessly transferring the brand’s essence into the physical space, developers can create an authentic and immersive brand experience for residents. Critical elements such as distinctive furniture ranges contribute to the overall co-branded environment. Failing to incorporate these essential components leads to superficial collaborations lacking genuine value.
Maintaining Brand Standards and Control

title: ROI & ROE in Real Estate Co-Branding | Ziad El Chaar Insights
content:
Once a co-branded project is delivered to clients, it is crucial to ensure that the brand’s standards are maintained. Owners’ associations play a pivotal role in this regard, as they become responsible for preserving the brand’s integrity within the building or community and adhering to the brand guidelines. To safeguard the brand’s reputation, it is essential for the co-branding partner to establish measures to monitor and control how their brand is being maintained in the property. Should the brand’s standards not be upheld, the brand should not hesitate to take necessary actions, such as withdrawing their association with the project.
The Future of Co-Branding in Real Estate

title: ROI & ROE in Real Estate Co-Branding | Ziad El Chaar Insights
content: As wealth concentration continues to rise globally, the demand for exclusive and luxurious products, including real estate, is on the ascent. Ziad El Chaar predicts substantial growth and an influx of upcoming co-branded projects for brands already engaged in real estate co-branding and those seeking to venture into this domain. With the convergence of fashion, luxury, and real estate,  developers have a unique opportunity to tap into the desires of discerning clients who crave exceptional and exclusive living experiences. In the realm of real estate, co-branding has evolved into a compelling strategy that merges the realms of fashion and luxury brands with exclusive property developments.

title: ROI & ROE in Real Estate Co-Branding | Ziad El Chaar Insights
content:
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of DarGlobal, emphasizes the significance of co-branding for clients, developers, and branding partners alike. By offering limited edition properties, co-branded real estate projects cater to clients’ longing for exclusivity,  providing both  financial and ego-driven returns. Developers benefit from the trust and credibility associated with renowned brands, while branding partners deepen their connection  with clients through immersive experiences. As co-branding continues to flourish in the  real estate industry, strategic implementation and  maintaining brand standards will be vital to ensuring the success and longevity of these collaborations. With the promising future ahead, the convergence of co-branding, real estate, and the desires of affluent consumers creates a landscape of endless possibilities for innovative and extraordinary living spaces.

If you have packed your bags with no destination in mind, prepare yourself to get a first-class ticket to one of the world’s most luxurious havens, the coast of the sun, Costa del Sol. It is a long stretch of Mediterranean coastline in southern Spain’s Andalusia region.
It is where luxury is a tradition, and nature is the standard beauty. Its impeccable nature provides a delicate mixture of elegance and comfort, tradition, and avant-garde. Enrich your senses with culture:

title: Costa del Sol | Best Things to Do | DarGlobal
content:
Costa del Sol is marked with the footprints of the greats, from the Romans to the Arabs. They didn’t just leave footprints behind but have easily turned it into one of Europe’s most important cultural centres.
Malaga, Costa del Sol, is the birthplace of one of the world’s most famous artists. With over 25 museums, Malaga is renowned as Picasso’s homeland, where Roman and Arab remains blend with contemporary culture.
Malaga welcomes fine art enthusiasts and invites you to indulge in a wide array of sensory entertainment and explore the urban art of Soho and Lagunillas streets, the historical Russian Art Museum, the futuristic Pompidou Centre and Malaga’s Picasso Museum.
Turn off your phone and disconnect:

title: Costa del Sol | Best Things to Do | DarGlobal
content:
Given this place’s wide range of possibilities, you will never run out of things to do or feel out of touch. With an estimated 320 days of sunshine per year, Costa del Sol is the ideal year-round vacation destination.
Luxury hotels provide wellness and relaxation options, including activities such as meditation, yoga, and beach massages, allowing you to find peace and a genuine sense of connection.
Finca Cortesin Hotel Golf & Spa is the perfect destination to unwind without sacrificing elegance or exclusivity. Finca Cortesin, one of Andalusía’s most remarkable and sought-after hotels, is a serene haven with palm-studded patios, perfumed Mediterranean gardens, and elegantly opulent suites.

These include two sensational outdoor pools, one with deep-jade tiles overlooking the Sierra Bermeja, the other an adults-only, Olympic-sized beauty with a Bali vibe. A 10-minute shuttle service runs to and from Finca Cortesn’s glam beach club, which features a navy-tiled infinity pool with views of the Mediterranean.
You can also expect royalty-like treatment at Finca Cortesin’s sensational spa. The hotel also employs professional personal trainers specialising in yoga or Pilates classes to be at your disposal at their fully equipped gym.

Puerto Banus is one of the most recognised luxury ports in the world. You can rent a yacht or a luxury catamaran and sail along the Mediterranean, enjoying 320 days of sunshine a year in an exceptional environment with comfortable maritime facilities.

Marbella, Benahavis, Estepona and Mijas are home to most of these courses. It is the first destination that comes to mind for golfers looking for a wide range of quality courses and an ideal climate for playing golf all year round while enjoying Costa del Sol’s natural beauty.

The Electronic Wallet aims to facilitate electronic cash transactions related to the Platform and Auctions. The Wallet will allow the User to:
Fund the Electronic Wallet through SADAD.
Return the Fee from the Electronic Wallet to a desired bank account subject to the terms hereunder

The User must have a registered account on the Platform
The User activates the Electronic Wallet through the Platform by providing the required information such as name, ID, contact information, etc...

title: Wasalt Real Estate Services
content: For the User to participate in Auctions, they need to fund an amount into their Wallet via a payment of SADAD’s generated invoice(s) from a bank account the User owns and is registered under his name within 48 hours of its generation otherwise, the invoice will be invalid. For the avoidance of doubt, in case the User is a company, institution, or charity, the amounts shall be paid to a bank account under the said corporation, institution, or charity’s name. This amount serves as a financial guarantee (“Bid Deposit”) to demonstrate the User’s financial capacity and ability to bid. The funded amount appears as a credit in the Wallet and is a prerequisite for participation.

title: Wasalt Real Estate Services
content:
Once the Auction starts on the Platform, the company will reserve the Bid Deposit in the case the User is the highest bidder, and such User will not be able to refund the amount to the Wallet until the Bidding Period ends and the Auction is either awarded or not. Other Users, who are not the highest bidder, can withdraw from the Auction at any time and transfer the Bid Deposit back to their Wallet.
If the Auction is not awarded to the User, the Company will release the reserved Bid Deposit, and the User will have the option to leave it in the Wallet for future Auction participation or transfer it back to any bank account owned and registered under the User’s name after providing all relevant and supporting document(s) (i.e.: official IBAN certificate).
